title: THE BACK VIEW
why: His order of 2026-10-12, make them all look better, and his answer 24, readable silhouettes first. Every body faced the camera all the time: aiming up the screen it still looked at you with both eyes, so which way someone was looking was only a pupil and a gun. Now a body aiming up the screen is seen from behind: the back of the head, the hair over where the face was or a bare crown and a neck line, no eyes, mouth or beard, the pack in the middle of the back with the team lamp on its strap, and the gun drawn behind the body. Facing down or sideways is the front view as before, and Curved keeps her outline.
now: Aiming up the screen now shows the back of a body: hair, pack and no face.
